activity_summary: You boarded at threepence, the first meal of the week. The penny loaf was short of the notch by a finger, and Mistress Ansell would not make a sermon of it. You gave her no new plot. The letter on the board has no day and was not sent. Alse still cannot read it. The firing sixpence was not collected. The horse is not hired.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Paid threepence, kept the letter, and offered no new plot.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Measured the loaf, asked with it in her hand, and did not collect the firing sixpence.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Saw the gap in the loaf and left the unread page unread.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Ate, and left the letters to the people who write them.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: It did not go. It has no day in it.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Then I am not owed a new one.
